proposed_widenings.name: passive_class_feature
proposed_widenings.justification: Reliable Talent is always-on with no activation decision, no use_count, and no reset cadence. The sole existing ClassFeatureMechanics family ('activation') mandates all three. A 'passive' family is needed for always-on class features that fire automatically under a trigger condition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you make an ability check that uses one of your skill or tool proficiencies, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_floor
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect replaces any d20 roll of 9 or lower with 10 — a conditional floor substitution. v4 has modify_roll_substitute, which could in principle cover this, but the exact shape (floor threshold + proficiency-gated trigger) may require an explicit variant rather than stretching modify_roll_substitute's semantics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10

notes: Reliable Talent is a pure always-on passive. Forcing it into 'activation' would require fabricating an activationCost, a use_count cap, and a resetCadence that have no counterpart in the SRD text — a misleading trace. The primary structural gap is the missing 'passive' family for ClassFeatureMechanics. The effect (d20 floor on proficient ability checks) is a secondary surface gap; v4's modify_roll_substitute is the closest existing atom but the proficiency-gated floor condition may warrant its own variant.
